source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    1. Recommand to directly connect SUT BMC and client to avoid VLAN tagging setup needed by switch.
2. Enter BMC Web UI ->  Network page to find VLAN setting.
3. Check Vlan information when it is enabled, there should be no typo, weird string.
4. Set a VLAN ID to BMC port.
5. Set the same VLAN ID to your client.

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
1. Vlan information should be displayed correctly.
2. BMC connection should be lost after step4.
3. BMC connection should be back after step5.

deepseek_columns.ai_commands: ipmitool -I lanplus -C 17 -H "$BMC_IP" -U "$BMC_USER" -P "$BMC_PASS" lan set 1 vlan id +5 2>&1; ipmitool -I lanplus -C 17 -H "$BMC_IP" -U "$BMC_USER" -P "$BMC_PASS" lan set 1 vlan id 2>&1 | grep -i vlan; echo ---print---; ipmitool -I lanplus -C 17 -H "$BMC_IP" -U "$BMC_USER" -P "$BMC_PASS" lan print 1 2>&1 | grep -iE "VLAN|IP Address|MAC"
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: set a VLAN id on ch1 via `ipmitool lan set ... vlan id`, then return `ipmitool lan print` VLAN/IP/MAC lines so the user confirms VLAN info displays correctly and can watch BMC connection drop then return on the switch.
deepseek_columns.risk: RISK: enabling VLAN re-tags the BMC LAN and will drop the current connection until the switch port is tagged to the same VLAN; must be coordinated with an operator/switch so the BMC can come back. State-changing network config.

original_test_intent: Verify BMC WebUI VLAN information/readability and a disruptive VLAN transition in which access drops before matching client tagging and returns afterward.
original_method: An engineer inspects WebUI and coordinates peer tagging; BMC/client network state and reachability are recorded.
manual_activity: Core acceptance includes visual WebUI text inspection and coordinated client/network tagging; an engineer must perform/observe it, while the agent can collect reachability/config evidence.
required_inputs: Allowed VLAN ID and BMC channel/interface
WebUI text criteria, alternate recovery and rollback
safety_requirements: Use isolated network and verify target to prevent VLAN leakage/loops.
Do not use placeholder `+5`, hard-coded channel or plaintext credentials.
Maintain alternate access before disruptive write.
No automatic retry; restore untagged/approved state.
agent_execution_scope: Collect config/read-back, packet/reachability and endpoint identity around engineer WebUI/client actions.
Do not claim UI readability or issue verdict.
engineer_actions: Inspect WebUI, approve/configure peer tagging and recover/restore BMC.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Its placeholder syntax/channel/secrets are rejected; read-back concept is useful.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use platform-documented VLAN control and secure credentials, with coordinated peer tag and rollback.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: WebUI inspection, BMC/client same VLAN, drop/return sequence and 10/10 minutes remain.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Snapshot state, visually verify WebUI, apply approved BMC VLAN, prove expected isolation, tag peer, verify identity-safe recovery, then roll back.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds safe transaction order, identity and rollback.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Retains visual UI and intentional drop/return.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Mis-tagging can strand management or leak traffic.

project_override_considerations: Project may direct-connect or use a switch; record actual topology and retain WebUI criterion.
expected_evidence: BMC tag and expected loss timeline

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Procedure and criteria describe a coherent staged VLAN transition; missing values/topology are inputs.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The case is clear and manually executable. Visual WebUI acceptance makes it MANUAL ONLY rather than blocked.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Reclassifies PACKAGE to MANUAL ONLY due source-required WebUI readability.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Adds expected isolation, identity and rollback evidence.

review_improvement: Makes the disruptive VLAN transition safe and proves both isolation and correct-path restoration.
independent_technical_reasoning: Automation can measure reachability, but the source explicitly accepts WebUI text/display and coordinated client settings; those human-observed configuration surfaces remain core.
